summary: Verified dialog.jsx base default width upgrade from sm:max-w-lg (512px) to sm:max-w-2xl (672px). Tested 10+ dialogs across the app at 1920x1080 + mobile 375x667. All explicit sm:max-w-* overrides correctly preserved by tailwind cn() merge; dialogs without explicit width now render at the new 672px default. No JS errors. No horizontal overflow on mobile.
action_items: Note (not a bug): Task description lists 'Audit Logs → View Log Detail' as a dialog that should now render at 672px, but AuditLogs.jsx line 358 has an explicit sm:max-w-lg (512px) override. tailwind-merge correctly keeps the explicit override, so it stays at 512px. If main agent intended Audit Logs to widen to 672px, the explicit sm:max-w-lg on that DialogContent must be removed (out of scope for the one-line iter 50 fix).

Note: Sales Entry / Customers Add dialogs could not be opened via Playwright in one test pass (timing/click race). Sales Data Add Entry was successfully measured at 672px on retry. The dialog.jsx change is purely CSS and cannot cause click failures.
No JS console pageerrors observed across login → inventory dashboard → gst-billing → sales-data → customers → audit-logs → hrms → payroll flows.
critical_code_review_comments: The one-line change in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/dialog.jsx (sm:max-w-lg -> sm:max-w-2xl) is minimal, focused, and behaves exactly as intended thanks to tailwind-merge via cn().
Mobile-first inset-x-4 base remains unchanged, so mobile rendering (343px on 375vw, with 16px side margins) is unaffected — verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 50 was a pure CSS dialog default-width upgrade. All explicit sm:max-w-Xxl overrides on individual DialogContent components are preserved via tailwind-merge. Dialogs without an explicit sm:max-w-* class now render at 672px (was 512px). Verified across GST Billing (7 dialogs), Audit Logs, Payroll, HRMS Departments, Sales Data, Users. No regressions detected.
